# Portuguese Localization Mod for Cities: Skylines II A complete European Portuguese (pt-PT) translation for Cities: Skylines II, adapted with clear terminology and a natural tone for Portuguese players.
## Requirements You must install **I18NEverywhere**, which enables this mod to translate other mods alongside the base game.
## Features * Full European Portuguese translation without changing the game's visuals or gameplay * More than 90 mods translated automatically via I18NEverywhere * All DLC region packs fully translated (US Northeast, US Southwest, Netherlands, Eastern Europe, Japan, France, and more) * Consistent glossary throughout — from base game to mods * Additional translations maintained on Crowdin * Frequent updates
## Special Thanks Special thanks to N7C, creator of the Thai version of this mod, for all the technical help and support.
## Mods Translated with I18NEverywhere Gameplay and simulation: Realistic Workplaces and Households, Public Works+, Change Company, Magic Garbage Tools and editors: Better Bulldozer, Node Controller, Anarchy, Road Builder, Asset UI Manager, Automatic Bulldoze and Repair Visual and UI: Texture Unifier, Road Visual Tweaks, First Person Camera Continued, Recolor Infrastructure: Prefab Asset Fixes, Universal Zoning System And many more — full list available on GitHub.
## DLC Support All paid region packs and content packs are supported, including Leisure Venues, Mediterranean Heritage, Urban Promenades, Bridges and Ports, and all building and road packs.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Compatibilidade com a atualização 1.6.0f1: traduzido o novo sistema de pintura de texturas no terreno, a categoria de Cercas (10 modelos base + 22 novos modelos regionais europeus e norte-americanos), descrições das sebes, linhas de contorno globais e a opção de efeitos visuais de neve - Novas traduções para vários mods e pacotes de assets recentemente adicionados - Ficheiro de mods reorganizado em subpastas por categoria (Ferramentas, Trânsito e Transportes, Edifícios e Assets, Veículos, Decoração e Paisagismo, Mapas) para facilitar a manutenção - Correções de capitalização e consistência terminológica em vários ficheiros
